sourceText: User request (translated from Chinese): For both newly-discovered bugs (concurrent DONE race crash, retired channel-lane reference), write a RED script and a GREEN fix to verify the problem and whether GREEN actually resolves it; then bundle both into one story and drive it to DONE.
normalizedOutcome: A losing concurrent DONE racer prints a clear explanatory message instead of crashing with a raw ENOENT stack trace, and field-regression-cli-smoke.js no longer exercises the retired lattice-review-channel lane as if it were forceable; both smoke test files pass end-to-end.
acceptanceClaim: node packages/main/dist/tasks/worktree-authority-smoke.js and node packages/main/dist/tasks/field-regression-cli-smoke.js both print their respective success lines with zero errors, and both new RED scripts correctly report their target defect is fixed (their own defect-still-present assertion fails).
